note: Dated markers on the supply chart. Policy markers are LTA/MOT decisions; tech markers are company targets, not Singapore launch dates (design premise 6).

policy.label: EEAI ends
policy.detail: EV Early Adoption Incentive (up to $7,500 off ARF) ends for EVs registered after 31 Dec 2026.

policy.label: Cat A/B review due
policy.detail: LTA recommendations on merging COE Cat A and B are due in the first half of 2027; any effective date is unknown.

policy.label: VES ends
policy.detail: The Vehicular Emissions Scheme runs to 31 Dec 2027; nothing has been announced after.

policy.label: 0% car growth ends
policy.detail: The 0% growth rate for Cat A and B COEs applies until 31 Jan 2028.

tech.label: BYD: first solid-state EV (small batch)
tech.detail: BYD targets limited all-solid-state production in 2027, mass production by 2030. Company target, not a Singapore launch date.

tech.label: Toyota: solid-state EVs (2027-28)
tech.detail: Toyota aims to launch all-solid-state EVs in 2027 or 2028, in limited batches. Company target.

tech.label: Nissan: first solid-state EV (FY2028)
tech.detail: Nissan says its first solid-state EV is on track for fiscal 2028. Company target.
